I have completed the mechanical audit across all eight areas, with all 15 login-safe tests passing and the Delta launcher confirmed safe. Here is the ruling.

---

# Post-implementation contract/code audit — conditional-information stress continuation
`omnifold_contract_auditor`, session `0d8740dd-…`. Read-only; no edits/delegation/compute. Scope: uncommitted continuation (`features.py` M + untracked `conditional_fixtures.py`, `conditional_stress_cli.py`, `aggregate_conditional_stress.py`, `g2_memmap*.py`, `sbatch_pet2_conditional_delta.sh`, tests, prereg, checkpoint design). Infrastructure (`contracts.aligned_signal_row`, `fixtures.ConditionalClosureFixture`, arm names) was committed in `59ca279…0396787` since `e530536`. No experiment outcomes exist; this audits the harness only.

## Mechanical verification (8 required items)

**1. Exclusive parent-invisible carriers + exact parent ties — CLEAR.** Pairs are made byte-identical via `_copy_rows` (low→high), then only the declared carrier is set on both members by sign (`conditional_fixtures.py:249-329`). Each carrier is provably invisible to the parent view: view→`C` zeros `view_id`; type→`C` forces `TYPE_GENERIC`; rich→`E-muon` zeros `vertex_z`; muon-token→carrier lives in `muon_coords` (parent is `global`, no token); overflow→carrier token is masked out by `C-truncated`. `pair_identical` over `continuous/coords/token_mask/type_id/view_id/globals` **raises** on any parent difference (`:411-428`); `_decode_carrier` must reproduce the constructed sign (`:430-432`); signal-mode `carrier_auc==1.0` enforced (`:442-443`). Parent analytic AUC 0.5 follows necessarily from verified pair-identity (ties).

**2. Within-split pairing/balance/shuffle chance + no bookkeeping leakage — CLEAR.** Pairs are split-local via `stable_partition` (`:188-215`); per-partition hidden-sign balance is enforced (`:555-566`, raises); `_shuffle_carrier` requires overall **and every-partition** AUC within 0.02 of chance or raises (`:218-246`). Bookkeeping (`h`, pair id, `w_reco`, event key, pass flags) is not a `TokenBatch` model field, so it cannot enter `density_ratio._torch_batch`; within a child pair the *only* per-row-varying model input is the declared carrier (parent ties + carrier).

**3. Full truth hashing / frozen Step 2 / misses / fake prohibition / D-S-B symmetry / literal bkg / signed-refined — CLEAR.** The aggregator requires a **single** `truth_tensor_sha256`, `truth_inventory_sha256`, `truth_arm_fingerprint`, `truth_model_config_fingerprint`, `truth_preprocessing_fingerprint`, `parameter_footing`, and `row_footing` across all 45 runs, both roles (`aggregate_conditional_stress.py:383-420`) — this independently guarantees the carrier never touched truth and Step 2 is frozen. Truth is never passed to the carrier functions. Fakes fail closed in `SignalInventory.validated`; signed provenance (data≥0/bkg≤0) and refined-nonnegative enforced in `MeasuredInventory.validated`; background refined training mass = 0 (`:479-482`); data = signal-reco subset and background carries the same schema (`_background_carrier`), so `concatenate_batches` schema-equality holds.

**4. Additive muon-token relational coordinates + overflow conservation — CLEAR.** `global+token` keeps `BASELINE_GLOBALS` and prepends the token (`features.py:139,255-256`); the fixture sets nonzero/finite `muon_coords` and two distinct recoil neighborhoods (`conditional_fixtures.py:289-302`), gated by the new `muon_token_coordinates_audited` capability. Overflow builds exactly one aggregate token whose energy equals the recorded `overflow_energy` (`:567-579`). (See MINOR-4: synthetic overflow "conservation" is tautological.)

**5. Controls / matched footing / pull-push-ESS / tails / projections / cap-10-30 count+mass — CLEAR.** Three modes (`signal`/`unity-sham`/`carrier-shuffle`). `density_ratio.calibrated_ratio` computes a dual/triple-cap sensitivity `{10,20,30}` with `saturated_count`, `saturated_reference_weight_mass`, and `reweighted_ess` (`density_ratio.py:90-115`); the engine stores `complete_iteration_receipts` (`engine.py:386-390`); the CLI computes pull/push log-ratio bias/MAE/RMSE vs the aligned analytic ratio, hidden-sign groups, global+declared-tail ESS (expected vs predicted), quantiles, projections, and full-order (`conditional_stress_cli.py:111-170`, `evaluation.py`). Matched rows/seeds/budgets are frozen by `_recipe` (fail-closed on drift, `:65-108`).

**6. Aggregate gates == frozen preregistration; rejects dirty/incomplete/mixed-footing — CLEAR.** `_mode_gates` implements the frozen thresholds exactly: signal (each-seed push RMSE ≤0.30, mean ≤0.25, ≥30% mean improvement, favorable all seeds, parent mean ≥0.35, global+tail ESS fidelity ≤10%, projection L1 ≤0.25, no cap-10/30 saturation, cap ESS shift <1%); unity-sham (both ≤0.15, ESS ≤10%, no saturation); carrier-shuffle (<15% improvement, carrier AUC within 0.02, no saturation) (`:265-355`). `_extract_run` rejects incomplete status, wrong evidence label, G2/publication claim, non-matched recipe, failed certificate, parent/enriched mismatch (`:135-157`); `aggregate` requires the exact 5×3×3 inventory, single source-commit, **no dirty runs**, and single-valued truth/parameter/row footing (`:358-420`).

**7. Production-G2 ZIP streaming / content-resume / locking / atomic / units / hashes / mutation-staleness / readonly memmap — CLEAR.** `convert_g2_npz_to_memmap` binds input SHA-256+size to the receipt (`g2_memmap.py:530`), streams each member with a bounded buffer + object-dtype rejection (`:163-164,257-281`), receipts per-array dtype/shape/order/**units** (with `q/p` and `time` explicitly flagged unverified, `:71-130`)/sha, recomputes row-family counts and legacy identity hashes (`:371-394`), resumes by re-hashing output **and re-reading source payload** (`:320-350`), holds an exclusive `flock` (`:544-549`), publishes atomically after `COMPLETE` binds the manifest sha, chmod 0444, dir-fsync (`:664-680`), and refuses to replace an existing output. The loader rejects stale/absent/mutated input, missing completion marker/array, dtype/shape/order/count and identity mismatch, and asserts read-only memmaps with bounded row windows (`:436-505,411-427`). Tests exercise every declared failure mode.

**8. Checkpoint-design separation / exactness / licensing / no-evidence — CLEAR.** Separate family `gregor-pet2-checkpoint-compat-v1` with distinct L (`legacy-exact`) and K (`corrected`) fingerprints, never cross-loaded with `independent-pet2-small-concept-match-v1`. It freezes source SHAs, exact PET2 presets/config, per-key state-dict schema, preprocessing transforms/units, PID vocabulary, mask/pad policy, safe loader (size+SHA before deserialize, no pickle exec, no `strict=False`/transpose/random/unreceipted-partial), a per-key remap manifest (PID 0→pad shift), and license/checksum. It honestly separates generic jet-pretrained weights from an (absent) MINERvA-fine-tuned checkpoint, gates any partial transfer as a non-promotable diagnostic, and keeps arm F `unavailable`.

## Findings

**BLOCKER:** none.
**MAJOR:** none.

**MINOR**
- **M1 — certificate presents three derived facts as hardcoded** (`conditional_fixtures.py:595,639,640`: `parent_analytic_carrier_auc=0.5`, `truth_modified_by_carrier=False`, `bookkeeping_excluded_from_model_tensors=True`). Each is a proven consequence of a verified check (pair-identity ties → AUC 0.5; truth never passed to the carrier; model consumes only `TokenBatch` fields) and truth-immutability is independently re-enforced by the aggregator's single-truth-hash gate. Recommend computing them (e.g., assert `truth_tensor_sha256` equals the pre-carrier base-fixture truth hash) for defense-in-depth. Non-gating.
- **M2 — `fault_after_arrays` fault-injection parameter in the production `convert_g2_npz_to_memmap` signature** (`g2_memmap.py:517,608-612`); defaults `None` (inert). Prefer a test-only seam. Non-gating.
- **M3 — the `.{name}.lock` sibling is not unlinked after successful publish** (`g2_memmap.py:542`, released via `flock` but file persists). Cosmetic; `flock` is fd-scoped so a residual lock file is harmless.
- **M4 — synthetic overflow "conservation" is tautological** (`:567-579`: the injected token energy equals the recorded `overflow_energy`). Acceptable for a channel-capacity test, but `overflow_energy_conserved` must not be read as evidence of real discarded-energy conservation; that remains a G2-dump concern (correctly deferred in the checkpoint/G2 docs).

## Authorization

- **Clean source commit: AUTHORIZED.** No BLOCKER/MAJOR; the four MINORs are advisory hardening and may be folded into the same commit or deferred. The commit must carry the products-summary/ledger/RUN_LOG/STATUS discipline and keep the `synthetic-fixture` / `g2_validation_claim=false` / `publication_promotion_permitted=false` labels already present throughout.
- **Matched Delta execution: AUTHORIZED.** The launcher is one-GPU, no-auto-submit (requires `SLURM_JOB_ID`), forbids the active checkout and shared output namespaces, has a self-test, consumes no G2, and fails closed on invalid family/mode/seed (`sbatch_pet2_conditional_delta.sh`). The frozen recipe is enforced in-code. Execution produces **channel-capacity harness evidence only**; it establishes neither that MINERvA data carries these conditionals nor any publication/architecture conclusion.

Boundaries reaffirmed: no literal G2 access or validation is claimed anywhere; the G2 memmap path is code-contract-only until the receipt-bound literal input exists; the Gregor-exact backend remains a design with arm F `unavailable`; no scientific winner and no AUC-as-evidence.

## Post-execution audit checklist (apply once Delta results land — no outcomes exist yet)

1. `git diff` of the result-bearing commit changes no estimator source or frozen prior products; only new `products/conditional_stress/**` + docs.
2. Aggregate loads exactly 45 runs (5 families × 3 modes × 3 seeds), single source-commit, `source_dirty=false` for all 90 arm results.
3. `common_footing` single-valued: `truth_tensor_sha256`, `truth_inventory_sha256`, `truth_arm_fingerprint`, `truth_model_config_fingerprint`, `truth_preprocessing_fingerprint`, `parameter_footing`, `row_footing`.
4. Per family/mode: single `dataset_fingerprint`, `control_footing_without_seed`, `certificate_fingerprint`; certificate `status==pass` with verified (not merely asserted) pair-identity, carrier decode, balance, refinement match, overflow, and shuffle-chance.
5. Signal gates evaluated exactly per prereg; parent mean RMSE ≥0.35 (exclusivity confirmed) and, if a family passes, it is labeled `pass-synthetic-channel-capacity` with `real_minerva_benefit_claim_permitted=false`.
6. Both negative controls present and passing per family: `unity-sham` (both arms ≤0.15) and `carrier-shuffle` (child improvement <15%, carrier AUC within 0.02).
7. cap-10/cap-30 count + weight-mass + ESS-shift telemetry present per arm/seed; no saturation; shift <1%.
8. Every product carries `evidence_class=synthetic-fixture`, `g2_validation_claim=false`, `publication_promotion_permitted=false`, and the channel-capacity-only interpretation string.
9. If the G2 memmap converter is ever run, its manifest is `code-contract`/no-G2-claim and the input is receipt-bound; no availability/validation claim appears.
10. Checkpoint design remains documentation-only; arm F `unavailable`; no L/K result pooling.
